content: {"phoneNote":"The hero photo sits almost entirely below the fold while two weak text links and a dead gap take its place, and the bottom of the page repeats address, directions and hours three times.","desktopNote":"The headline is broken into four giant one-word lines that swallow the left half of the screen, while contact details and hours are repeated across the booking section, the footer block and the footer line.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":2,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":2,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Merge the booking section, 'Obiščite nas' and the footer into one contact block with a single address, directions link and set of hours; drop the duplicate hours table.","Shrink the hero headline to two lines on desktop and pull the photo above the fold on phone; make 'Naročite se' a real primary button instead of an underlined link.","Replace the reused balayage photo in 'Kdo vas počesa' with a portrait of Tina or a different shot, and tighten the empty bands around the booking section on desktop."],"blockers":["Both viewports, 'Kdo vas počesa': the same balayage photo from the hero is reused as the inset picture.","Both viewports: address, directions link, phone and email are repeated in the booking section, 'Obiščite nas' and the footer, and hours appear twice.","Desktop and phone full page: the sticky header lands over the hero headline, clipping the top of 'Pričeska' on desktop and splitting headline from buttons on phone."]}
